results.name: users
results.sql:
CREATE TABLE users (
  token_hash TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  user_id    TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  label      TEXT
, recovery_hash TEXT, role TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'user'
  CHECK (role IN ('user', 'admin')), email TEXT, created_at TEXT, username TEXT, username_normalized TEXT, password_hash TEXT, password_updated_at TEXT, auth_version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, is_active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1)

results.name: snapshots
results.sql:
CREATE TABLE snapshots (
  user_id    TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  version    INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  updated_at TEXT,
  payload    TEXT NOT NULL          -- 整份 App JSON 快照（字串）
)

results.name: user_ai_credentials
results.sql:
CREATE TABLE user_ai_credentials (
  user_id          TEXT NOT NULL,
  provider_id      TEXT NOT NULL,
  binding_json     TEXT NOT NULL,
  key_ciphertext   TEXT,
  nonce            TEXT,
  key_version      INTEGER,
  version          INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (version >= 1),
  deleted          INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (deleted IN (0, 1)),
  last_mutation_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at       TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (user_id, provider_id),
  FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(user_id),
  CHECK (
    (deleted = 0 AND key_ciphertext IS NOT NULL
      AND nonce IS NOT NULL AND key_version IS NOT NULL)
    OR
    (deleted = 1 AND key_ciphertext IS NULL
      AND nonce IS NULL AND key_version IS NULL)
  )
)

results.name: ai_default_catalog_releases
results.sql:
CREATE TABLE ai_default_catalog_releases (
  version          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK (version >= 1),
  config_json      TEXT NOT NULL,
  credentials_json TEXT NOT NULL,
  mutation_id      TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  request_digest   TEXT NOT NULL,
  published_by     TEXT NOT NULL,
  published_at     TEXT NOT NULL
)

results.name: user_sessions
results.sql:
CREATE TABLE user_sessions (
  token_hash   TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  user_id      TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_at   TEXT NOT NULL,
  expires_at   TEXT NOT NULL,
  device_label TEXT, auth_version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(user_id)
)

results.name: pairing_codes
results.sql:
CREATE TABLE pairing_codes (
  code_hash  TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  user_id    TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_by TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  expires_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  used_at    TEXT,
  FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(user_id)
)

results.name: articles
results.sql:
CREATE TABLE articles (
  owner_user_id     TEXT NOT NULL,
  id                TEXT NOT NULL,
  title             TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  body              TEXT NOT NULL,
  analysis_json     TEXT,
  source_type       TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'paste',
  source_url        TEXT,
  revision          INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (revision >= 1),
  created_at        TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at        TEXT NOT NULL,
  deleted_at        TEXT,
  legacy_article_id TEXT,
  last_mutation_id  TEXT,
  size_bytes        INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  PRIMARY KEY (owner_user_id, id),
  FOREIGN KEY (owner_user_id) REFERENCES users(user_id)
)

results.name: article_changes
results.sql:
CREATE TABLE article_changes (
  owner_user_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  seq           INTEGER NOT NULL,
  article_id    TEXT NOT NULL,
  op            TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (op IN ('create', 'upsert', 'delete', 'restore')),
  revision      INTEGER NOT NULL,
  updated_at    TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (owner_user_id, seq),
  FOREIGN KEY (owner_user_id) REFERENCES users(user_id)
)

results.name: article_state
results.sql:
CREATE TABLE article_state (
  owner_user_id        TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  next_seq             INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  pruned_before        INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  legacy_write_blocked INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  migrated_at          TEXT,
  updated_at           TEXT NOT NULL,
  FOREIGN KEY (owner_user_id) REFERENCES users(user_id)
)
